assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded as I25.10.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered with CPT code 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197.
